title: Count Cold Days
description: A weather station recorded n daily temperatures. Read an integer threshold and the n readings, then count how many days were strictly colder than the threshold, using a loop and an accumulator. A reading t counts only when t < threshold; a reading exactly equal to the threshold does not count. This is the transfer variant of 'Count Divisible Numbers': same loop-bounds and accumulator skill, different surface story and filter predicate. Implement your solution in Java inside the provided Main class; read from standard input and print the answer to standard output.
constraints: Each of the n temperatures satisfies -100 <= value <= 100
input_format: First line: two integers n and threshold separated by a space. Second line: n integers (the daily temperatures) separated by spaces.
output_format: A single integer: how many of the n temperatures are strictly below threshold.
